description: Use this when the user wants to find open jobs in the modern power sector: grid, nuclear, renewables, data-center power. Searches active postings on nextgenenergyjobs.com by keyword, employer, location, sector, seniority, job type, remote and posted date. Battery storage has no sector of its own: search it with query. Returns 10 jobs per page, newest first (by the date the job was first seen), with a link and a slug for get_job. Pay shows when the listing has pay data; estimates are labeled. Not for jobs outside energy, resume writing or applying.

company.description: Employer name, e.g. "Fervo Energy". An unknown name returns 0 jobs and similar names. Wins over sector when both are set.

location.description: One city, US state, or country, e.g. "Texas" or "Denver, CO". For a metro area use its main city (Bay Area -> San Francisco) or the state. No zip codes. Spell out non-US regions (Ontario, Canada).

posted_within.description: Only jobs posted within the last 24 hours, 7, 30 or 90 days.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "electrical engineer" or "battery storage". Skip for browse-only searches.

remote.description: true = jobs flagged remote in the listing.

sector.description: Sector slug. Call list_sectors for what each one covers.

with_salary.description: true = only jobs with pay data. Estimated pay is included and labeled "estimate".

name: search_jobs
title: Search energy jobs
